Privacy policy.

Last updated 2026 · Governed by the laws of Ghana and the Data Protection Act, 2012 (Act 843).

Terms & conditions privacy@dakyworld.com
  1. Home
  2. Privacy
01

Introduction

Dakyworld (‘we’, ‘us’, ‘our’) operates the dakyworld.com website and related services. This policy explains how we collect, use, disclose and safeguard your personal data, in line with Ghana's Data Protection Act, 2012 (Act 843). By using our services, you acknowledge that you have read and understood this policy.

02

What we collect

Contact information (name, email, phone, company, job title); usage data (IP address, browser, pages visited); client data (website content, databases and credentials, only when you authorise us to manage your systems); and payment data (processed via Stripe, Paystack or bank transfer — we do not store card numbers).

03

Data security

We apply SSL/TLS encryption in transit, encryption at rest for sensitive data, regular security audits, and strict need-to-know access controls. All client credentials — server access, database logins and admin passwords — are stored in a zero-knowledge password-management vault, never in plaintext, email or shared documents.

04

AI tools & automated processing

Some services involve AI-powered tools. We use enterprise tiers that contractually exclude your data from model training. Client operational data processed through our AI and automation pipelines is never used to train public or third-party AI models — this is an explicit guarantee.

05

Third-party processors & cross-border transfer

We may share data with hosting providers, payment processors, analytics tools, email providers, and the AI and automation platforms used to deliver contracted services. Some processors may store data outside Ghana; where this occurs, we take reasonable steps to ensure protection consistent with the Data Protection Act, 2012.

06

Your rights

Under the Data Protection Act, 2012 you may access, correct or delete your personal data, withdraw marketing consent, and lodge a complaint with the Ghana Data Protection Commission. To exercise these rights, email privacy@dakyworld.com with the subject ‘Data Request’. We respond within 10 business days.

07

Data retention & contact

We retain personal data only as long as necessary; for monthly partnership clients, for the engagement plus one year. On termination we delete or anonymise your data within 30 days unless law requires otherwise. Questions: privacy@dakyworld.com, Kumasi, Ghana.

Questions about anything on this page? Email privacy@dakyworld.com with the subject ‘Data Request’ and we will respond within 10 business days.

Dakyworld is your outsourced digital systems and automation team for growing businesses in Ghana and West Africa. We build, connect and improve the systems that help businesses win customers and operate more efficiently.
